name: codex-ssh-password
description: Connect Codex to SSH servers using a local password prompt or private key, prevent duplicate sessions, and show chat titles in a live monitor.

interface.shortDescription: Connect to SSH servers without exposing the password to chat.
interface.longDescription: Local Windows MCP bridge for password or saved-key SSH. Low-token defaults return small file, command, and directory outputs; increase limits only as needed. Credentials stay local. Matching chat connections are reused; remote writes use Codex approvals.
